description: Start or recover an asynchronous x402 conformance scan. For new origin-only calls, this MCP tool defaults to quote_mode fast and returns an unsigned 402 quote without starting a scan. Capability-only recovery requires the original input or proof; use get_scan_status for capability polling. Resend the same arguments with payment_signature only after independent payment authorization. Supplying idempotency_key without quote_mode retains compute-first admission. Save the job/capability and poll. Never signs payments.

idempotency_key.description: Required for compute-first mode. Omit both this and quote_mode for the MCP tool's unsigned fast quote. Retain any supplied key for retries.

origin.description: Public HTTP(S) origin only; no credentials, path, query or fragment. Use paths for same-origin paths.

name: scan_origin
